fact: US company Cybastion committed $75 million to digital infrastructure in Cameroon, including an AI-ready data center in Douala with a dedicated power plant, according to Biometric Update; the document gives no signing date beyond 'days' after early September 2026, so the month is inferred from that.

MTN Cameroon says it is investing US$225 million over three years in its own operations in Cameroon, particularly its fintech division and national network coverage; the financier is the company itself (MTN, a private telecoms operator), no separate recipient, and the document gives 2025 as the year, taken from its published date.
